title: Clamp a hanging file folder around a packet and hang it on frame rails
instruction: Hang the file folder on both top rails of the file frame with the document packet still inside it.
context: Office clerks and administrative staff routinely pinch both top rods of a hanging file folder together around loose papers and hook all four rod ends onto drawer or desktop file rails.
setup: Two 6-DOF arms with parallel-jaw grippers sit at (0.00, +0.305) m and (0.00, -0.305) m along the near edge of a station desk (top z = 0.7475 m). Four 1:1 rigid objects sit on the desk: (1) a fixed steel desktop inbox riser (200 x 130 x 32 mm) centered at (0.1750, 0.0000) m; (2) a fixed Officemate 91990 letter-size steel hanging file frame set to its 14 in (355.6 mm) depth from x = 0.4250 m to 0.7806 m (317.6 mm center-to-center rail span at y = +-0.1588 m, 238 mm rail height to z = 0.9855 m, with a 4 mm-high front U-saddle bottom bar leaving a 311.6 x 226 mm open front throat); (3) a loose V-hinged Pendaflex 4152 letter-size hanging file folder (two 298.5 x 230 x 2.5 mm pressboard leaves joined at an un-sprung 9.2 mm bottom V-gusset crease hinge, each topped by a 328 mm coated-steel hanger rod with underside rail-hook saddles at y = +-0.1588 m, 0.16 kg total) resting flat on the inbox riser with its bottom crease at x = 0.0720 m and overhanging top rods at x = 0.3045 m; and (4) a loose manila document packet (280 x 195 x 6.0 mm, 0.20 kg) resting inside the folder between the two leaves.
scoring: Final state only: 0.0 if any point of the folder or document packet lies more than 30 mm below the desk top (off the desk). Every positive score requires all six gripper pad/jaw points at least 80 mm clear of the folder, packet, file frame, and inbox riser, and under 1.0 mm 3D extremal-point motion across the final 21 samples (1.0 s at 20 Hz). 0.5: all four top hanger-rod hook saddles (front-left, rear-left, front-right, rear-right) seated on the left and right top rails (within 4.5 mm vertically and 6.0 mm laterally of the rails, x within [0.440, 0.766] m) with the folder bottom crease suspended at least 5.0 mm clear above the desk. 1.0: 0.5 met and the manila document packet retained upright inside the V-folder (packet center nested between the front and rear leaves, lateral offset within folder bounds, and packet minimum z suspended at least 5.0 mm above the desk).
fidelity: Frame and folder match 1:1 Officemate 91990 letter-size frame at 14 in depth (355.6 x 317.6 x 238 mm) and Pendaflex 4152 letter hanging folder (328 mm rod span, 298.5 x 230 mm leaves). Pressboard leaves and packet are rigid box colliders joined at an un-sprung crease revolute joint with estimated inbox riser, rail/hook saddle geometry (3.6 mm rail inside 7.2 mm saddle), hinge damping, and friction (0.45-0.58); paper flex is omitted.
